The '''Fengrine system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|Star system]] found in the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. it contained the [[Agriworld/Legends|agri]]-industrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Fengrine/Legends|Fengrine]].
